summary: Palatine emigrant who sailed on the Windsor in 1753 and settled in Williams Township; probably John's 6th-great-grand-uncle.
bio: Johann Peter Grub was born at Jettenbach, in the parish of Reichenbach, on 29 February 1724 and baptized at Reichenbach on 5 March. He is thought to have been a son of Johann Nickel Grub and a brother of Andreas Grub, which would make him John's 6th-great-grand-uncle. On 2 January 1749 he married Maria Amalia Grill at Offenbach am Glan, where children were born to them in 1750 and 1752. In 1753 the family sailed to America on the Windsor and settled in Williams Township. About 1759 he took a second wife, Magdalena. He appears in the 1800 census as Peter Krub and died on 24 August 1802.

researchNotes:
Johann Peter Grub (1724-1802), presumed brother of Andreas, arrived on the Windsor in 1753 and settled in Williams Twp.

FamilySearch places Johann Peter in Johann Nickel Grub's family, which supports his being Andreas's brother. It gives his birth at Jettenbach on 29 Feb 1724 (baptized at Reichenbach on 5 Mar 1724) and his marriage at Offenbach am Glan on 2 Jan 1749 to Maria Amalia Grill, with children born at Offenbach in 1750 and 1752, just before the 1753 Windsor voyage. It also gives a second wife, Magdalena, about 1759, the 1800 census as 'Peter Krub', and his death on 24 Aug 1802 ([R4-S1]).
